business_scope.primary_industry_name: Maritime Seafarer Staffing and Vessel Crew Management Agency

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - English common law heritage, Samoan statute, and customary law under the Constitution of the Independent State of Samoa 1962
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations) - regional free trade and investment facilitation framework in force for Samoa

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended); International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2017; Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act 2007 (as amended by AML/CFT reforms of 2018); Financial Intelligence Unit Act (as amended); and related AML/CFT directives administered by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit and the Registrar of International Companies.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of each UBO's valid passport and proof of residential address
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent authority in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization at the Samoan Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade or Samoan overseas mission; Samoa is not an Apostille Convention member, so apostille is generally not accepted alone

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified extract of directors and shareholders of any corporate shareholder or parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registrar of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization with certified English or Samoan translation; attach originating registrar certificate and notarization before legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or notarized bank reference letter concerning the UBO's or principal shareholder's financial standing and business background
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: The UBO's or principal's relationship bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization followed by consular legalization where required; bank signatures must be authenticated

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: AML/CFT due-diligence questionnaire and PEP/sanctions/negative-media screening report
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Samoa-licensed registered agent or independent AML/CFT compliance screening provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Internal registered agent file, not public; to be produced to the Registrar or Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit upon supervisory request

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, shareholders, signatories, and agents against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC SDN List, HM Treasury consolidated list, INTERPOL notices, and domestic Samoan AML/CFT directives. PEP screening must cover individuals with or previously entrusted with prominent public functions during the preceding 12 months, their immediate family members and close associates. Enhanced due diligence is required for PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, and transactions involving politically exposed foreign entities. All screening results must be documented in the registered agent's client file and retained for at least five years after termination of the business relationship, consistent with FATF Recommendations 12 and 24.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa Companies Registry Online Name Search and Reservation Portal, operated by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) - Companies and International Companies Registry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names may be in English or Samoan. Official registration records are maintained in English; names must use the Roman/Latin alphabet; non-English and non-Samoan names must be transliterated into a Latin-script form for search and registration. The name must end with an approved corporate suffix such as Limited, Ltd, Corporation, Corp, Incorporated, or Inc. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name and must not be misleading as to the company's business or legal status.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, attaching the name-search report, the registrar's refusal letter, and grounds for appeal. The Registrar must determine the appeal within 21 business days. If the refusal is upheld, the applicant may seek ministerial review before the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour or judicial review before the Supreme Court of Samoa. A new alternative name may be reserved while the appeal is pending, but the contested name remains blocked until final determination.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permitted. A virtual office may be used for administrative correspondence, but the International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Samoa at the office of a licensed registered agent, not a P.O. Box. For a ship crew recruitment agency, the Samoa Maritime Administration and MCIL will expect demonstrable local crew-management substance, including a licensed local crewing agent or sub-agent, MLC 2006 compliance, and access to crew records. A purely virtual shell may fail the commercial substance review required for the maritime recruitment licence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderately elevated; approximately 40% probability of an unannounced AML/CFT or maritime licensing inspection in the first operating year, rising to about 60% over the first three years due to the active crew recruitment licence and risk-based supervisory programme.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2011; sections 5-12 (incorporation), section 22 (registered office), sections 95-110 (directors, secretary, and corporate governance); Maritime Transport Act 2013, Part IX (seafarer recruitment and placement licensing)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 Application for Registration as an International Company, together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association (Form IC-MA) and Declaration of Compliance (Form IC-DC)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under the International Companies Act 1987; the Company may be incorporated with one or more shares and zero paid-up capital. Authorized capital is commonly set at USD 10,000 in the Memorandum. No escrow account is required for International Companies under SIFA practice.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by the subscribers and sole incorporator, that: (1) The subscribers hereby subscribe for the ordinary shares set out opposite their respective names in the Register of Members, and the initial authorized share capital is adopted as stated in the Memorandum of Association; (2) The registered office of the Company is fixed at the registered-agent office address in Apia, Samoa, pursuant to Section 22 of the International Companies Act 1987; (3) Mr./Ms. [Name] is appointed first director, to serve until the first annual general meeting; (4) Mr./Ms. [Name] is appointed Company Secretary; (5) The director is authorized to pay incorporation fees, open bank accounts, adopt the company seal, and apply for the Samoa Seafarer Recruitment and Placement Service License.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Clearance and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an original name-reservation request through a SIFA-licensed registered agent. Provide three ranked proposed company names; the Registry checks against the international and domestic company registers for confusing similarity or prohibited terms. Upon approval, the name is reserved for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Registered Agent Engagement Letter (SIFA Form IC-RA1)
Three proposed company names
Certified copy of passport of each shareholder and director
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement under 3 months old)
Completed due diligence questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused on similarity grounds, the agent may file a written appeal with the Registrar within 14 days, or resubmit an alternative name without additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent; Notary Public; Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade (Apostille for offshore execution)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles using the SIFA standard-form IC M&A template. Each subscriber must execute the document before a witness acceptable to the registered agent. If signed outside Samoa, the execution page must be notarized and apostilled, and the certificate of incumbency of the notary submitted.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (Form IC-MA)
Consent of subscriber to act as shareholder (Form IC-CS)
Power of attorney if subscriber signs by attorney
Apostilled or notarized execution pages (if offshore)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: SIFA returns a defective M&A with a requisition letter; the agent must amend and re-execute the document and resubmit within 21 calendar days to avoid a re-filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Form IC-1 and Payment of Statutory Incorporation Fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 Application for Registration as an International Company, together with the executed Memorandum and Articles and the Declaration of Compliance, and pay the SIFA registration fee of US$200 plus any apostille and courier disbursements.
required_dossiers: Form IC-1 signed by the registered agent
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Declaration of Compliance (Form IC-DC)
Receipt of registration fee payment
Name reservation certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a query is raised, the Registrar issues a notice of defect; the agent has 30 days to cure, failing which the application lapses and the fee is partially refunded under SIFA practice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registry endorses the Memorandum and issues the Certificate of Incorporation, thereby creating the International Company as a separate legal person with limited liability.
required_dossiers: Incorporation file reference (automatically generated)
Payment confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where certification is delayed beyond the SLA, the agent may request expedited issuance from the Registrar; typographical corrections are effected by filing Articles of Correction (Form IC-AC).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Corporate Governance Recordals
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent and First Director; SIFA corporate records maintained by the licensed agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting, or pass a unanimous written consent, to adopt the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution, approve share subscription, adopt the registered office, appoint directors and officers, and authorize the opening of bank accounts.
required_dossiers: Minutes of First Board Meeting or Written Consent Resolution
Consent to Act as Director (Form IC-D1)
Consent to Act as Secretary (Form IC-S1)
Registered Office Consent Form (Form IC-RO)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify any inconsistency in the register by filing a Notice of Change of Director or Secretary (Form IC-C1) with SIFA; late filing may attract a default penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Seafarer Recruitment and Placement Service License and Physical Clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Maritime Safety Administration of Samoa (MSAS), Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure, with clearances from Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) and Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a crew recruitment agency licensing application under the Maritime Transport Act 2013 to MSAS, demonstrating compliance with Maritime Labour Convention 2006 obligations, financial capacity evidenced by P&I insurance or bank guarantee, and office premises clearances.
required_dossiers: MSAS Seafarer Recruitment Agency application form
Certificate of Incorporation and company extract
P&I insurance certificate or bank guarantee
Statement of MLC 2006 compliance
Staff CVs and training records
SFESA fire clearance certificate
MNRE waste management registration for low-impact office activities
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the license is opposed or queried, the applicant may submit further evidence within 20 working days; an appeal lies to the Minister of Works, Transport and Infrastructure within 30 days of refusal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Maritime Safety Administration of Samoa (MSAS), Shipping and Maritime Division, Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure (MWTI)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Seafarer Recruitment and Placement Service License (Crew Manning Agency Permit) under the Maritime Transport Act 2013

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Environment and Conservation Division, Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 – EIA Registration (low-impact, office-only activities); no full EIA Report required
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or VOC emission source at the registered office; solid office waste must comply with the Samoa Waste Management Regulations 2015; any wet or oily marine waste from crew-change or vessel-support activities must be handled under MARPOL Annex I/IV/V requirements through contracted waste-reception facilities.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: SFESA Fire Clearance Certificate for office occupancy; MWTI Building Division structural load inspection and occupancy permit; workplace health and safety registration under the Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013 administered by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (Samoa), Apia; administers the Income Tax Act 2012, Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2011, Tax Administration Act 2016 and Customs Act 2014; taxpayer portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws (online TIN application and VAGST return filing via the Revenue Management System).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Incorporate the International Company (IC) with the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, under the International Companies Act 1987 (ICA), filing the Memorandum and Articles of Association, registered-office consent and a declaration that no business will be carried on in Samoa. Step 2: The licensed Samoan registered agent submits the TIN application (Form TIN) to the Ministry for Revenue, attaching the certificate of incorporation, certified passports of directors and shareholders, registered-office particulars and a brief description of the crew-recruitment activity. Step 3: The Ministry issues a seven-digit electronic Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) within approximately 5 to 10 business days. Step 4: No income tax registration is required because the IC is statutorily exempt from income tax under ICA s.202; a Certificate of Exemption may be obtained from the Registrar for documentary purposes. Step 5: If the IC makes taxable supplies in Samoa above the VAGST threshold, or voluntarily elects VAGST registration, a separate VAGST registration (Form VAGST-REG) must be filed with the Ministry for Revenue.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: The Samoa International Company is a ring-fenced, statutorily exempt entity under ICA s.202, relieved from income tax, corporation tax, withholding tax, capital gains tax, stamp duty and all other Samoan taxes and duties, provided it does not carry on business within Samoa. The exemption is automatic and not subject to annual renewal, but the IC must maintain accounting records and may be required to file an annual return with the Registrar.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or elective pass-through mechanism exists under Samoa law; the ICA tax exemption is mandatory and not elective. Available elections are: (i) voluntary VAGST registration under VAGST Act 2011 s.10 where turnover is below the WST 100,000 compulsory threshold, allowing input-tax recovery on Samoan purchases; (ii) conversion from IC status to a domestic company under the Companies Act 2001 (registrable with the Registrar) if the entity wishes to conduct local activities and become subject to the Income Tax Act 2012; and (iii) election to acquire a local business or land licence under the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2015, which ring-fences the permitted local activity and subjects that specific activity to Samoan domestic taxation. Hybrid-mismatch rules under the Income Tax Act 2012 (as aligned with BEPS Action 2) operate by denial of double-deduction outcomes and do not confer any elective treatment on an IC.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) administered under the VAGST Act 2011 (as amended by the VAGST (Amendment) Act 2019) and the Tax Administration Act 2016.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 (Samoa Tala) annual value of taxable supplies; registration is compulsory for any person making taxable supplies above this threshold (VAGST Act 2011 s.10), voluntary registration is available below the threshold, and exports of goods and offshore services are disregarded for both nexus and threshold computation purposes.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or API-based electronic-invoicing mandate is currently in force in Samoa. The Ministry for Revenue operates an electronic Revenue Management System (RMS) for VAGST return lodgement and payment, but invoice data transmission is not required at the point of issue. Tax invoices must contain the title 'tax invoice', supplier name, address and TIN, recipient name and TIN (where registered), description of supply, quantity, price excluding tax, VAGST amount, and issue date. All invoices and supporting export documentation must be retained for at least 7 years for audit inspection.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to exported goods and international services under VAGST Act 2011 s.31. Crew recruitment and vessel manning-agency services (ISIC 5222) are eligible for the 0% rate when: (i) the recipient is a non-resident shipowner, ship manager, or overseas crewing principal not registered for VAGST and not carrying on business in Samoa; (ii) the service is supplied from Samoa to the foreign vessel or offshore principal and is not connected with land in Samoa under the place-of-supply rules; (iii) the IC holds a written manning/recruitment agreement with the offshore principal identifying the vessel, flag state, crew complement and fee structure; and (iv) consideration is paid from outside Samoa. Where inputs in Samoa attract VAGST, the IC may claim a refund through the quarterly VAGST return; input tax on exempt or unregistered activities is not creditable.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (E-DEC) lodged asycuda world system, Customs Division, Ministry for Revenue
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill issued to the foreign consignee evidencing shipment from Samoa
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a Samoan commercial bank confirming export proceeds credited to the IC's Samoan account
Commercial invoice and detailed packing list
Manning/crew recruitment agreement with the non-resident shipowner or ship manager evidencing the offshore service supply
Crew employment contracts, seafarer certificates and vessel particulars supporting the service (for crew-agency zero-rating audits)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry for Revenue may audit zero-rated export claims at any time within the 7-year record-retention window. Where zero-rating is claimed fraudulently or without adequate export substantiation, the Ministry will (i) claw back VAGST at the 15% rate on the supply, (ii) impose late-payment interest of 10% per annum plus incremental penalties under the Tax Administration Act 2016 s.55 and VAGST Act 2011 s.49, (iii) apply administrative penalties of up to 25% of the tax sought where false documentation is tendered, and (iv) initiate criminal prosecution for tax evasion carrying fines of up to WST 200,000 and/or imprisonment for up to 5 years. The ICA s.202 tax exemption does not extend to VAGST on local supplies, and directors may be jointly and severally liable under ICA s.107 for reckless false statements. Discrepancies between export declarations, bills of lading and inward remittance certificates trigger automatic audit review and can suspend the IC's zero-rating status.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Samoa's central bank and monetary authority)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tala (WST) is legal tender and freely convertible for current-account transactions, including crew recruitment agency service fees, subject to general Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Financing of Terrorism (AML/CFT) vetting. Capital-account transactions, including inward direct investments and shareholder loan injection, are non-resident and may be routed through offshore foreign-currency accounts without Samoan local exchange-control approval for International Companies. Profit remittance by a Samoa International Company is permitted where funds are derived from non-Samoan sources and no Samoan tax liability crystallizes; however, remittances incorporating Samoan domestic receivables attract current-account treatment, documentary verification of the underlying service contract, and Central Bank of Samoa notification thresholds. The practical convertibility hurdle is compliance substantiation rather than statutory inconvertibility; robust source-of-funds and source-of-wealth dossiers are indispensable for any conversion into WST or onward FX transfer.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Samoa does not impose a mandatory surrender ratio on export proceeds for International Companies. The Exchange Control Act 1978 requires resident exporters of goods to repatriate proceeds to the domestic banking system within 180 days and to account for the disposition of foreign exchange, but this rule does not apply to non-resident-owned International Companies that operate solely in foreign currency and maintain no WST domestic activity. Crew recruitment agencies classified as ISIC 5222 providing cross-border maritime staffing services are treated as exporters of services; to the extent receipts are lodged in a Samoan resident account, the bank will record the transaction under the current-account register but no prescribed conversion ratio applies. Where an offshore foreign-currency treasury account is used, no surrender obligation arises in Samoa, subject to a clean audit trail and customary periodic returns to the Central Bank.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Samoa Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-Low. Samoa has not identified a licensing regime for foreign fintech Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs); only public bodies supervised by the Central Bank of Samoa may issue e-money. Consequently, a purely offshore digital EMI cannot independently operate a Samoan WST account or clear domestic wire transfers. Nevertheless, an International Company may lawfully use a reputable foreign EMI (authorised in a FATF-compliant jurisdiction) as a non-Samoan payroll collection and disbursement engine for USD, AUD, or NZD settlements provided no Samoan-resident counterparty is involved and the EMI itself does not hold itself out as a Samoan bank. The principal legal constraint is that such an EMI account does not constitute a Samoan banking relationship and therefore cannot be used to satisfy the SAMOA International Company statutory substance requirement or the bank-account-evidence milestones under a physical-presence licence application. A tier-1 Samoan bank account remains the anchor for compliance, licensing, and Central Bank interaction.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Samoan law, via the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Act 2010 and the Central Bank's KYC/AML directives, requires client due diligence, including the identification of all beneficial owners. In almost all tier-1 banks, at least two directors (or a duly appointed natural person with power of attorney) are required to appear in person at a physical interview at the bank's branch in Samoa. Remote video onboarding is permitted only for an individual ultimate beneficial owner who is not a director and only after enhanced documentary verification; remote opening for the company itself is generally not available for International Companies. The bank will require the articles of association (in Chinese or English with certified translation), certificate of incorporation, register of directors and shareholders, proof of physical office address in Samoa, evidence of the company's intended shipping crewing business, and a bank-to-bank reference. Chinese-language corporate documents are accepted provided each page is certified by a notary and, where applicable, apostilled, and accompanied by a sworn English translation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership opacity through layered Chinese traditional family trusts or common-law trust structures
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Trust deed and executed governance instruments; certificate of trusteeship from the licensed trust company; trust registration or Certificate of Incorporated Trust (where applicable); register of beneficial owners maintained under the Samoan International Companies Act; valid passports of settlor, protector, and at least one natural-person beneficiary; notarial certificate of source of wealth and source of funds; bank reference from the underlying trust bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value multi-currency payroll payments to a large non-resident seafarer crew triggering enhanced sanctions and human-trafficking screening
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete seafarer employment register; employment contracts and crewing agreements; STCW (Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping) certificates and flag-state licence for each crew member; crew list and passport copies; payroll ledger with PCI-compliant disbursement data; crew welfare and repatriation insurance policies; written undertaking affirming no sanctioned persons, vessels, or cargoes are involved.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unanticipated inbound wire received under a transaction purpose code inconsistent with the declared crew-recruitment business model
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial invoice and charter/crewing contract showing the service flow; vessel name and IMO number; beneficial ownership register of vessel owner; voyage order and disbursement request; country-specific tax identification numbers of the payer and payee; Central Bank of Samoa current-account service declaration where the remittance is denominated in WST or touches the domestic system; board resolution approving the treasury template.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound founder or family-trust capital injections should be routed via SWIFT MT103 to the Samoa International Company's tier-1 operational multi-currency account. The remitter must specify an unambiguous purpose code, typically 'GDR' (capital contribution) or '284' (trade credit), and must include the company name, share register reference, and a copy of the board resolution authorising the capital subscription or shareholder loan. The bank will require the Certificate of Incorporation, the register of shareholders, evidence of economic substance in Samoa (office lease, resident agent), and an audited source-of-funds statement if the amount exceeds the bank's threshold. For shareholder loans, the loan agreement should be notarised and apostilled; the funds must remain in the company's name and not be commingled with trust assets. Inbound transfers to the escrow/capital account should be structured to preserve traceability and to match the regulatory return to the Central Bank of Samoa, where applicable.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound crew payroll and subcontractor settlements are cleared primarily via SWIFT MT103 in USD, AUD, or NZD. For large-scale international seafarer labor placements, a commercial letter of credit (L/C) can be used as a settlement rail against delivery of crew mobilisation documentation, including STCW certificates, sickness and personal accident insurance, and repatriation confirmations. Standby letters of credit may also be used as performance guarantees in the crewing agreement. All outbound remittances are subject to the paying bank's sanctions screening, screening against the SAMOA/UN sanctions lists, and payment transparency rules under the AML/CFT Act. The bank will require underlying service contracts, tax-compliant invoices, and a boarded crew verification report. Same-day high-value wires may be effected via the swift global payment innovation (gpi) tracker to reduce intermediary costs and improve auditability.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts on WST/USD or WST/AUD executed through an offshore counterparty for non-resident International Companies
Plain vanilla spot deferral forwards in USD, AUD, and NZD for payroll disbursement hedging
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) used in long-term ship charter or crew-vessel financing structures
FX options (European-style) for asymmetric protection of crew payroll and dividend remittance cashflows

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form IC-AR) and registered agent declaration of compliance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 100 per month; failure to file for 3 months may trigger administrative strike-off and forfeiture of assets to the Samoan Government

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of Certificate of Registration / Good Standing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 1 June each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Renewal fee default attracts a 10% late surcharge; continued non-payment beyond 6 months leads to suspension of corporate status and strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation of statutory agent and registered office details
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent (licensed by SIFA), acting on behalf of Registrar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Agent must report changes to the Registrar within 14 days; omission may invalidate the company's legal standing and subject the company to administrative dissolution

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: International Companies are generally audit-exempt; independent audit becomes mandatory if demanded by a shareholder resolution on voting rights of 5% or more, or if required by the maritime regulatory authority under a statutory crew manning license (e.g., evidence of financial solvency).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Samoa (Samoa Equivalent to IFRS); no statutory obligation to file audited financial statements with the Registrar for International Companies unless the company is licensed as a financial institution or maritime manning entity.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent must obtain an annual written confirmation from the International Company identifying all beneficial owners and any shareholding transfers. Changes in beneficial ownership must be notified to the agent within 14 days, but no separate public UBO register is filed with the Registrar; the agent maintains the confidential beneficial ownership register.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - 6,000 per year (only if audit trigger applies)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate for a qualifying Samoa International Company (IC): statutory exemption from income tax and stamp duty under the International Companies Act 1987, no capital gains tax, and no tax on foreign-source income; the only annual charge is the government fee of WST 500 to WST 1,000. The exemption is lost if the IC carries on business in Samoa, in which case the 27% resident rate applies to Samoa-source income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA) Company Income Tax Return (Form IR-C1), filed electronically through the SRA e-Services portal at Matafele, Apia; paper filing only with prior SRA approval.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; provisional tax is paid in quarterly installments during the income year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Return must be filed within 6 months after the end of the income year (a 31 December balance date is due by 30 June of the following year); final assessed tax is payable with the return; provisional installments fall due on 15 June, 15 September, 15 December and 15 March.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN), registered address and industry classification code (ISIC 5222).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the foreign entity name, home jurisdiction and any appointed Samoa agent; state the WST translation of foreign-currency records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax residence status and basis of assessment: resident worldwide income or non-resident Samoa-source income only.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select non-resident; attach the foreign Tax Residency Certificate when treaty relief is sought.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross assessable income (WST) from all sources for residents, or from Samoa sources for non-residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An exempt IC declares nil assessable income; crew payroll and foreign commission receipts are excluded from the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exempt income, deductions, depreciation and crew wage expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim the International Company exemption; deduct only expenses incurred in producing Samoa-source assessable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income and tax computed at 27%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a valid exempt IC the amount is nil; provisional tax is not payable while the exemption remains effective.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credits, provisional tax paid, refund claimed or balance due.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach credit computations and SRA receipts for provisional tax payments.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: WST 200 per month of delay, capped at WST 2,000; late payment: 20% surcharge on unpaid tax plus statutory interest at 2% per month compounding; shortfall penalties range from 25% for unintentional error to 150% for intentional evasion; criminal conviction adds fines up to WST 100,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return and Substance Declaration (Form IC-AR), lodged with the Registrar of International Companies through the Samoa e-Registry portal; no income tax return is required for a validly exempt IC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual on each anniversary of incorporation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 3 months after each anniversary of incorporation; the annual government fee is payable with the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name, registration number, incorporation date and registered office address in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the local registered agent address and the foreign directors' residential addresses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors, shareholders, secretary and shareholding percentages.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident individuals must append passport or identity declarations under the Companies Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic substance declaration: relevant activity type, number of employees, operating expenditure, premises and location of core income-generating activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Crewing agency is a service-centre activity; describe the crew-hiring decisions, payroll processing and contract negotiations performed in Samoa.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification of no domestic trading activity, no local-source income and no land ownership in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors must sign a penalty-certified declaration confirming the IC exemption status.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and fee default: WST 500 per month of delay plus interest; persistent non-filing results in strike-off from the register, disclaimer of assets, director disqualification and travel bans pending clearance.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa has a limited double taxation agreement network, chiefly Tax Information Exchange Agreements, and no broad comprehensive DTA with major capital-exporting states. Where a comprehensive DTA is in force, the beneficial owner must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate from the foreign tax authority, file the SRA treaty relief notice with a beneficial ownership declaration, and submit both to the Samoa Revenue Authority before the payment date or claim a refund within 3 years after year-end; the payer must retain the approved certificate or the statutory 15% withholding applies.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: interest 15% and royalties 15% gross; comprehensive treaty rates, where applicable, typically reduce the rate to 10%; no domestic zero-rate exemption is available, and payments routed through shell entities are disallowed under economic substance rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 1,000,000 (aggregate annual cross-border related-party transactions requiring a Local File; Master File and Country-by-Country Report are required for multinational groups meeting the OECD EUR 750 million consolidated revenue threshold where the ultimate parent is resident in Samoa).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. The International Companies (Economic Substance) Amendment Act 2018 and the International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2019 impose a managed-and-controlled-in-Samoa test on ICs conducting relevant activities, including distribution and service centres. A crew-recruitment agency must perform its core income-generating activities in Samoa, maintain premises, local employees and operating expenditure commensurate with the activity, keep local records, and file an annual substance declaration; failure triggers information exchange, penalties, loss of exemption and strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Absence of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the Samoa IC as a nominee shell with no physical office, no local employees, no board minutes in Samoa, and no annual substance declaration, while falsely representing that crew recruitment and payroll functions are performed in Samoa.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of the statutory tax exemption; reassessment of 27% corporate income tax plus a 150% shortfall penalty and interest; administrative strike-off and deregistration; disclosure as a shell entity under exchange-of-information mechanisms.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false substance declarations are jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax and penalties; courts may pierce the corporate veil, order civil restitution, impose a travel ban preventing departure from Samoa, and sentence directors to imprisonment for up to 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Carrying on an actual physical crew-management business in Apia without a domestic business licence or tax registration, understating commission income, or paying undisclosed dividends from the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment of back taxes for up to 7 years, 150% evasion penalty, statutory interest at 24% per annum, fines up to WST 100,000, and mandatory closure of the unlicensed operation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors with wilful blindness are personally liable for corporate tax debts; criminal conviction carries imprisonment up to 5 years, asset forfeiture and repatriation restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Breach in Crew Payroll Remittance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Collecting seafarer wages and disbursing funds via Swift wire and multi-currency payroll without a money transmission licence, AML/CFT registration, customer due diligence on crew members, or filing of Suspicious Transaction Reports with the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines up to WST 500,000 per breach under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018, freezing and confiscation of payroll funds, revocation of the crew recruitment licence, and mandatory reporting to foreign supervisors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face personal fines, disqualification, travel bans and asset restraint, and imprisonment for up to 7 years where funds are derived from criminal activity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Manipulation and Thin Capitalization
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying excessive intercompany management fees to affiliated crewing companies, earning artificially high margins, or failing to maintain a Local File when related-party transactions exceed the WST 1,000,000 threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Arm's length adjustment, disallowance of deductions, 50% documentation shortfall penalty, statutory interest, and recharacterization of excess payments as deemed dividends subject to 15% withholding tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve non-commercial pricing are liable for the resulting tax deficiencies; the corporate veil is pierced in cases of intentional interposition, allowing seizure of personal assets and travel restrictions pending settlement.
